title.narrative: Operationalizing Institutional Mechanisms for Performance Accountability in the Philippines Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth

description.narrative: The objective of the proposed IDF is to build the capacity of relevant offices within PhilHealth (Office of the Chairman of the PhilHealth Board or OCOP, Governance, Audit and Investments Committee of the Board) and Corporate Planning Department to operationalize institutional mechanisms for comprehensive (bottom-up, top-down) performance accountability. The proposed grant activities are as follows. Component A: Support to the PhilHealth Board including the Office of the Chairman of the PhilHealth Board, Governance, Audit and Investments Committee to explore mechanisms for strengthening performance accountability within PhilHealth with an emphasis on: (a) identification of tools and mechanisms to hold PHIC accountable for performance based on international and national good practices and standards for good corporate government (for example the performance governance system developed and recommended by the Institute of Corporate Directors), (b) identification of mechanisms for full implementation vis-a-vis the PhilHealth Board (frequency of reporting, responsibilities for review and feedback mechanisms). Component B: Support to PhilHealth Corporate Planning Department (CorPlan) to operationalize a performance accountability tool around the medium-term plan and as agreed with the PhilHealth Board, including: (a) identification of such tools and institutional mechanisms for implementation at all levels of PhilHealth (including at the level of Regional offices and for human resources management), (iii) identification and implementation of organizational change management mechanisms for the institutionalization of the performance accountability tool (for e.g. to spell out plans to cascade information, rewards and incentives). The development objective of the proposed IDF is to build the capacity of relevant offices within PhilHealth (Office of the Chairman of the PhilHealth Board or OCOP, Governance, Audit and Investments Committee of the Board) and Corporate Planning Department to operationalize institutional mechanisms for comprehensive (bottom-up, top-down) performance accountability.
